menu:4043170:1.text: I can't wait to see you in action!
menu:4043170:1.source_cn: 让我也见识一下魔法师神奇的炼金术吧！

say:1:1224655001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I talk to you for a second?
say:1:1224655001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I talk to you for a second?
say:1:1224655001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I talk to you for a second?

say:2:1224655002:1.text: Some Water Wights have escaped from prison, and word is they're planning a rebellion through arson.
say:2:1224655002:1.source_cn: 有些水鬼帮越狱了，传来消息说要纵火造反。
say:2:1224655002:1.male: Some Water Wights have escaped from prison, and word is they're planning a rebellion through arson.
say:2:1224655002:1.female: Some Water Wights have escaped from prison, and word is they're planning a rebellion through arson.

say:3:1224655003:1.text: <style="stress">Century Forge</style>, <style="stress">the lower district</style>, <style="stress">Sanctum Square</style>, and our <style="stress">training area</style>—they're likely to target these places.
say:3:1224655003:1.male: <style="stress">Century Forge</style>, <style="stress">the lower district</style>, <style="stress">Sanctum Square</style>, and our <style="stress">training area</style>—they're likely to target these places.
say:3:1224655003:1.female: <style="stress">Century Forge</style>, <style="stress">the lower district</style>, <style="stress">Sanctum Square</style>, and our <style="stress">training area</style>—they're likely to target these places.

say:4:1224655004:1.text: I'll be interrogating the accomplices who helped with the breakout for clues.
say:4:1224655004:1.source_cn: 我在这审讯协助越狱的同伙，看看有没有新的线索。
say:4:1224655004:1.male: I'll be interrogating the accomplices who helped with the breakout for clues.
say:4:1224655004:1.female: I'll be interrogating the accomplices who helped with the breakout for clues.

say:5:1224655005:1.text: Could you check out the places I just mentioned?
say:5:1224655005:1.source_cn: 麻烦你去排查一下这几处了。
say:5:1224655005:1.male: Could you check out the places I just mentioned?
say:5:1224655005:1.female: Could you check out the places I just mentioned?

say:2:1224656001:0.text: Magister! What can I do for you?
say:2:1224656001:0.source_cn: 哟！魔法师，什么风把你吹来了？
say:2:1224656001:0.male: Magister! What can I do for you?
say:2:1224656001:0.female: Magister! What can I do for you?

say:3:1224656002:1.text: Hugin, Lucca said the escaped Water Wights might start a fire here!
say:3:1224656002:1.source_cn: 呼金，卢卡说越狱的水鬼帮可能会在你这纵火！

say:4:1224656003:1.text: Muahahaha! Don't worry, I've prepared for it.
say:4:1224656003:1.source_cn: 呼哈哈哈哈！不用担心，我早有准备。

say:5:1224656004:1.text: I have the recipe for a special fireproof coating! But now, I still need one more material.
say:5:1224656004:1.source_cn: 防火涂料——独家秘方！不过，现在缺个东西。

say:6:1224656005:1.text: I already had Sinbad prepare all the material for you ages ago. Everything's here; feel free to use anything you need!
say:6:1224656005:1.source_cn: 早就让辛巴达帮我把材料都备好了，今天可算是把你这个大忙...
say:6:1224656005:1.male: I already had Sinbad prepare all the material for you ages ago. Everything's here; feel free to use anything you need!
say:6:1224656005:1.female: I already had Sinbad prepare all the material for you ages ago. Everything's here; feel free to use anything you need!

document:0:90:0.text:
This coating has speckles that resemble crystal dust exhaled by a ferocious beast from a frosty land.
It can be applied to any surface to insulate against heat transfer.
It is generally made of 3g of <style="stress">perlite</style>, 10g of <style="stress">waterstone</style>, and 1 piece of <style="stress">froststone</style>.
document:0:90:0.source_cn:
仿佛极寒之地的巨兽呼出的冷息一般，微冷的晶屑逸散在空中，是这款涂料呈现在世人眼中的视觉特点。
可涂抹在任何物体表面，以隔绝温度和火焰的传导。
一般由<style="stress">珍珠岩</style>3g，<style="stress">流水石</style>10g，<style="stress">冷晶石</style>1颗炼制而成。
document:0:90:0.male:
This coating has speckles that resemble crystal dust exhaled by a ferocious beast from a frosty land.

It is generally made of 3g of <style="stress">perlite</style>, 10g of <style="stress">waterstone</style>, and 1 piece of <style="stress">froststone</style>.

say:1:1224657001:0.text: Woah! With just a wave of your hand, a magical chemical reaction takes place among those materials! How incredible!
say:1:1224657001:0.source_cn: 噢嚯！你的手一挥，材料一放进去，这些东西就产生了神奇的...
say:1:1224657001:0.male: Woah! With just a wave of your hand, a magical chemical reaction takes place among those materials! How incredible!
say:1:1224657001:0.female: Woah! With just a wave of your hand, a magical chemical reaction takes place among those materials! How incredible!

say:2:1224657002:1.text: How is it done? I think your alchemy has a lot in common with forging!
say:2:1224657002:1.source_cn: 是怎么办到的呀？总感觉这种炼金术和锻造有相同之处！
say:2:1224657002:1.male: How is it done? I think your alchemy has a lot in common with forging!
say:2:1224657002:1.female: How is it done? I think your alchemy has a lot in common with forging!

say:3:1224657003:1.text: Oops! I almost forgot you have urgent matters to take care of. Go ahead.
say:3:1224657003:1.source_cn: 嚯！差点忘了你还有急事要办，去吧。
say:3:1224657003:1.male: Oops! I almost forgot you have urgent matters to take care of. Go ahead.
say:3:1224657003:1.female: Oops! I almost forgot you have urgent matters to take care of. Go ahead.

say:4:1224657004:1.text: Let's chat again about alchemy next time!
say:4:1224657004:1.source_cn: 以后有机会，再和我好好说道说道炼金的门路哈哈！
say:4:1224657004:1.male: Let's chat again about alchemy next time!
say:4:1224657004:1.female: Let's chat again about alchemy next time!

say:0:1224658001:0.text: Let's check for flammable items here.
say:0:1224658001:0.source_cn: 我们找找这里有没有什么易燃物吧。

say:0:1224658101:0.source_cn: 快看！这些是打包好的易燃物。

say:0:1224658201:0.text: There are quite a lot here as well!
say:0:1224658201:0.source_cn: 这里的易燃物也不少嘛！

say:0:1224658301:0.text: There are so many flammable items hidden at this crowded square...
say:0:1224658301:0.source_cn: 在颂神广场人流这么大的地方，竟然藏了这么多易燃物……

say:2:1224659001:0.text: Magister, now that we've checked out all the potential targets, should we go after the Water Wights?
say:2:1224659001:0.source_cn: 主人，这些区域都排查过了，接下来我们做什么？去抓越狱的...
say:2:1224659001:0.male: Magister, now that we've checked out all the potential targets, should we go after the Water Wights?
say:2:1224659001:0.female: Magister, now that we've checked out all the potential targets, should we go after the Water Wights?

say:3:1224659002:1.text:
Since we don't know where they're hiding, how about we wait for them in ambush?
Hmm, we need to find a good spot...
say:3:1224659002:1.source_cn: 我们不知道他们藏在哪里，要不躲起来蹲守他们？\n唔，躲...
say:3:1224659002:1.male:
Since we don't know where they're hiding, how about we wait for them in ambush?
Hmm, we need to find a good spot...
say:3:1224659002:1.female:
Since we don't know where they're hiding, how about we wait for them in ambush?
Hmm, we need to find a good spot...

say:4:1224659003:1.text: They'll probably come back to set fire to the flammable items. Let's wait at the <style="highlight">Wind Wall</style> and catch them all in one fell swoop!
say:4:1224659003:1.source_cn: 这帮水鬼应该会返回藏了易燃物的地方点火，我们埋伏在锈锚...

say:0:1224659101:0.text: Magister, it's getting dark. Those Water Wights have indeed shown up!
say:0:1224659101:0.source_cn: 主人，天黑了，那帮水鬼果然出现了！
say:0:1224659101:0.male: Magister, it's getting dark. Those Water Wights have indeed shown up!
say:0:1224659101:0.female: Magister, it's getting dark. Those Water Wights have indeed shown up!

say:0:1224660001:0.text: Sir Chippy's bringing all of you to justice!
say:0:1224660001:0.source_cn: 可恶的水鬼！仓鼠骑士满满，把你们抓去血薇帮！

say:1:1224661001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have no idea how to thank you.
say:1:1224661001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have no idea how to thank you.
say:1:1224661001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have no idea how to thank you.

say:2:1224661002:1.text: Anyway, Rustport is lucky to have you.
say:2:1224661002:1.male: Anyway, Rustport is lucky to have you.
say:2:1224661002:1.female: Anyway, Rustport is lucky to have you.
